entries.desc: A focused regression fixture creates a DONE story whose test evidence matches its recorded evidence head, then adds a later unrelated material commit; done_closure reports evidence-freshness pass for that DONE story.

evidence.note: done-preflight-smoke now creates an isolated DONE story snapshot, commits a later unrelated material change, and asserts evidence-freshness remains pass for the completed story.

entries.desc: The reproduction does not mutate completed production stories like B-a57f or B-22b0; it uses an isolated temp repo fixture.

evidence.note: The regression uses temporary git fixture roots; it does not mutate completed production stories B-a57f or B-22b0.

entries.desc: The regression fails before the fix when DONE story freshness is compared against current HEAD materialHash.

evidence.note: The new regression specifically protects against the previous current-HEAD materialHash comparison; under that old behavior the post-DONE later material commit would make the DONE evidence-freshness row fail.

entries.desc: For story.phase=DONE, the DONE oracle compares test-evidence materialHash with the material tree at evidence.headHash and returns pass when they match.

evidence.note: done-oracle checks story.phase === DONE and compares evidence.materialHash to currentMaterialHash(root, evidence.headHash), producing pass when the recorded snapshot matches.

entries.desc: For story.phase not DONE, the DONE oracle still uses current HEAD/materialHash freshness and blocks stale active evidence.

evidence.note: Smoke output includes active TEST evidence freshness coverage: a later material commit still makes active TEST evidence-freshness fail.

entries.desc: If the recorded evidence head cannot be resolved or its material tree does not match evidence.materialHash, DONE story freshness fails closed rather than silently passing.

evidence.note: Smoke includes fail-closed DONE snapshot cases for uninspectable or mismatched recorded evidence snapshots.

entries.desc: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-preflight-smoke.js passes and includes a post-DONE main movement regression.

evidence.note: done-preflight-smoke passed and prints the completed-story regression line: DONE evidence freshness PASS after later material commit.

entries.desc: Regression coverage also proves active TEST evidence still fails freshness after material changes.

evidence.note: done-preflight-smoke also asserts active TEST evidence freshness still fails after material changes, so pre-DONE strictness is preserved.

entries.desc: Smoke output and assertions do not claim Authority Server receipt completion or weaken Authority receipt paths.

evidence.note: The fix and smoke only affect local DONE projection freshness; no Authority receipt, productionDone, fullAuthorityDone, or receiptVerified semantics are changed or claimed.
